strings.name: Natalie Portman
strings.summary: Portman began as a young performer in Léon: The Professional and developed her career alongside university study. Black Swan earned an Oscar; Jackie and May December explore identity, performance and public image. Her Hebrew-language feature A Tale of Love and Darkness extended her work into adaptation and direction.

strings.influence.rationale: Black Swan and other performances established international influence, alongside women’s filmmaking and advocacy for education and gender equality.
